Unlock Requirements

Interact with the Ratnik on the ground, northeast of the southern waypoint in <color=#ece5d8>Dreadshade Mire</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Location -</color> <color=#ece5d8>Dreadshade Mire, Nod-Krai</color>
The player can teleport to the nearest waypoint and move northeast.

The quest starts when the player interacts with a Ratnik laying on the ground, who reveals his name to be Januzs.
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Investigate the sealing pillars (0/3)</color>

At the initial Sealing Pillar, move west to find an arrow of kuuvahki energy.
Approach the arrow and follow it back to the Sealing Pillar
Abyssal Riftlines will appear in the player’s way, but can be purged by using Spireblooms.
Upon reaching the Sealing Pillar, Wild Hunt enemies will spawn, with the first wave being composed of.

customize.name: Wilderness Exile
customize.desc:
A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come.
All who dwell beneath the moon set out on journeys with their own goals and wishes in mind, but not all such wishes receive favor. Spirits that cannot rest due to engendered resentment, partings with loved ones, or desires that go unfulfilled, if corrupted by the Abyss, may transform into ghouls, forever lost in the thick mists of the Wild Hunt.

customize.text: Once the first wave is dispatched, a portal will open bringing in the last opponent.

customize.name: Wilderness Hunter
customize.desc:
A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come.
Many great champions of a lost ancient kingdom lie buried beneath the frozen northlands. Though the remnants of the past have been long wiped clean, these noble spirits yet defend their golden homeland. Awakened by Abyssal taint, these warriors now see all who trespass as prey.

customize.text:
With their defeat, Abyssal Riftlines are the last thing blocking the Sealing Pillar, and must be destroyed by using Spireblooms again.
As the Sealing Pillar is cleansed, an Exquisite Chest will spawn nearby.
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Investigate the sealing pillars (1/3)</color>

At the northwestern Sealing Pillar, the player will find another arrow of kuuvahki energy at the south, which must be approached to lead it to the Sealing Pillar.
Evil Eyes of the Blightseeper will manifest around the Sealing Pillar to guard it.
To destroy these enemies, the player must reflect their incoming attacks with the Spirebloom shield, by releasing it right when the attack makes contact.
Once that is done, the Sealing Pillar will be freed.
Additionally, an Exquisite Chest will spawn nearby.
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Investigate the sealing pillars (2/3)</color>

At the northern Sealing Pillar, the arrow of kuuvahki energy can be found to the west of it and once again it must be approached in order to lead it to its pillar.
Upon approaching the Sealing Pillar, a gauge indicating Abyssal Corrosion will appear, and Wild Hunt enemies will spawn.
Dispatch the enemies until the gauge is depleted in order to cleanse the Sealing Pillar.
Additionally, an Exquisite Chest will spawn nearby.
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Defeat the "Serpent of All Evils"</color>

Ride any of the Moonlanes emerging from a Sealing Pillar to enter the containment field where the “Serpent of All Evils” awaits.
Waves of Wild Hunt enemies will spawn, and their defeat will cause the health bar of the “Serpent of All Evils” to decrease.
The first wave is comprised of:

All who dwell beneath the moon set out on journeys with their own goals and wishes in mind, but not all such wishes receive favor. Spirits that cannot rest due to engendered resentment, partings with loved ones, or desires that go unfulfilled, if corrupted by the Abyss, may transform into ghouls, forever lost in the thick mists of the Wild Hunt.

customize.text: The second wave contains:

customize.name: Fisher of Hidden Depths
customize.desc:
An Abyssal creature that slips through rifts in the hidden depths, crossing over from beyond this world.
Long ago, an ancient philosopher described humans as "featherless bipeds," using that simple phrase to distinguish mankind from animals and assert human superiority. In some sense, these deathless wanderers of the silent cosmic void, scaled instead of feathered, and using their hooked beaks to draw in biomass from world to world, might actually also match that same simplistic definition of "human."

<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Talk to the Lightkeeper</color>

With the enemies defeated, Januzs and Oskari will approach for a dialogue.
Finishing the talk with them will complete the quest, and two Precious Chests and a Luxurious Chest will spawn nearby.
